params.cdstart: Starts on-cast, but restarts each time an empowered attack is used as well as after casting Upheaval
params.notes:
;General
* The empowered attacks can be parried and will not trigger the area of effect if either the target {{tip|block|blocks}} or {{tip|dodge|dodges}} the attack, or if the attacks miss while '''Skarner''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
** The attacks will be still consumed in all cases regardless.
** Note that if the main target is not blocking or dodging, then the area of effect can still deal damage to those who do.
* ''Shattered Earth'' ends prematurely if '''Skarner''' initiates a {{si|Recall}} channel.
* The empowered attacks have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} against champions, minions, and turrets only.
** {{Note|1}} Prior to [[V14.9|Patch 14.9]], the windup was uncancellable regardless of the target's type. It is currently unknown if the change was intentional or not, but seems to be partially intentional based on observation.
** Empowered attacks against other units can be {{tip|interrupted}} by crowd control or casting {{ai|Ixtal's Impact|Skarner}}, but not by issuing [[Controls_and_Hotkeys#Player_Movement|movement commands]].
* The aforementioned unit types, as well as monsters, inhibitors, and the nexus are considered "valid" for ''Shattered Earth'' and will only trigger its effects when the main target was one of those. This includes:
** Triggering the damaging area of effect,
** Refreshing the duration when an empowered attack has begun,
** and consume empowered attacks only when they landed. (This way the attacks are not consumed when the target died beforehand.)
* Attacking any other units will cause '''Skarner''' to use his normal basic attacks instead while ''Shattered Earth'' is expiring (but still benefit from the increased attack speed and range).
* To be more precise about ''Ixtal's Impact's'' duration pause, it adds {{fd|0.25}} seconds to the duration every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, but will set it to an estimated minimum of {{fd|1.5}} seconds if it would have been lower.
* The {{tip|slow}} applied by ''Shattered Earth'' is a generic slow debuff.<!-- It means that it uses the basic slow buff, not a unique one, which may or may not cause issues in some context (like pre-rework Naafiri W + Stridebreaker bug. - Vita -->
* ''Shattered Earth'' is special cased to generate a stack of {{iis|Spear of Shojin}} {{nie|Focused Will}}.
* Only the third hit of ''Shattered Earth'' triggers {{ii|Tear of the Goddess}} and {{iis|Archangel's Staff}} {{nie|manaflow}}.
;Interactions & Other
* The attack reset will not save time if '''Skarner''' possesses sufficiently high attack speed because of the ability's {{fd|0.35}} seconds cast time. Starting from around {{sti|{{as|271.4285% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, basic attacking is fast enough to match the time with the reset and will be even faster with more, causing ''Shattered Earth'' to actually slow down the user at that point.
** However, this only takes attack speed into account and ignores various other factors, such as the damage and other bonuses from the ability and the fact that '''Skarner''' generally does not like building such high amounts of attack speed. Additionally, attempting to do the attack reset at such high attack speed is already a hard task, if not requires frame perfect execution to save any [[Tick and updates|ticks]] worth of time.
;Known issues
* '''Skarner's''' attack speed is not immediately updated upon casting ''Shattered Earth''. Beginning the first attack shortly after casting results in an attack that does not benefit from the attack speed granted by the ability.
* If ''Upheaval'' hits an enemy while a new instance of ''Shattered Earth'' is active, ''Shattered Earth's'' effects are immediately lost.
* While ''Shattered Earth'' is active, it will not benefit from cooldown refund effects such as {{ri|Transcendence}} or {{iis|Navori Flickerblade}} {{nie|Transcendence}}.
** {{Note|1}} This is not a '''Skarner'''-specific issue. Various abilities, including Ultimates, that grant a different ability in their slot after activation may suffer from this problem (e.g. {{cai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}} and {{ai|Snack Attack|Briar}}) and may be fixed or may have been fixed on a case-by-case basis.
* The empowered attacks lack spell effects as they deal {{tip|proc damage}}, which does not match with how empowered attacks supposed to behave in general.
** {{Note|1}} This is possibly a band-aid fix to avoid an issue where ''Shattered Earth'' would trigger various effects twice per attack instead of once, as it could be seen during the first PBE deploy of the rework's release, after which the ability was changed from spell damage to proc.
* The buff used for ''Shattered Earth'' is fuzzy. Each attack removes 1 stack on a delay of up to {{fd|0.25}} seconds. This has no known side effects currently.
* The slow is also applied and removed in a fuzzy manner, meaning that sometimes it may last shorter or longer than intended, depending on the ticks.
params.tips:
* Rather than asking if using the final attack or the throw is worth more, instead think and decide about '''when''' to use the throw.
* When attempting to engage in from safety with ''Ixtal's Impact'', you should consider pre-emptively casting ''Shattered Earth'' in most situations. Trying to do it after the engage leaves you more vulnerable as you have to wait for the cast time '''WHILE''' in champion combat.
* Similarly, learning when and how to use ''Shattered Earth'' is the most vital part when you begin to play Skarner. It makes the gameplay experience very punishing when used neglectfully.
* As already mentioned in ''Impale's'' description, casting ''Impale'' while ''Shattered Earth'' is active will immediately forces ''Upheaval'' to be cast with no cast time. This can be utilised for more efficient damage dealt when optimised or even gaining surprise takedowns against fleeing enemies.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Skarner''' charges forward in the direction of the cursor for up to {{fd|2.75}} seconds, during which he gains {{tip|slow immunity}}, becomes {{tip|ghosted}}, ignores [[terrain]]  collision, and has {{tip|unobstructed vision}} of the surrounding 650 units. He automatically navigates his movement along the way and is able to steer himself with a slow turn rate that increases over time, resetting upon changing direction. ''Ixtal's Impact'' can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after the duration.
params.description2: '''Skarner''' begins the charge at a {{tt|static amount|Cannot be modified by any means}} of {{sti|{{as|150 movement speed}}}} that increases by {{as|100|ms}} every {{rutngt|0.25}}, up to {{as|950 '''total''' movement speed}} by the end of the duration. If '''Skarner''' collides with an enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, he grabs them with his claws for the time of the remaining charge, {{tip|attach|attaching}} them to himself, {{tip|suppression|suppressing}} them, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them, increasing the charge's turn rate to the maximum, and gaining {{as|300 '''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}, with a minimum total of {{as|650|ms}} and a maximum total of {{as|1150|ms}}. If a target has been grabbed before the first {{fd|1.75}} seconds of the charge, the remaining duration is set to 1 second, and set to {{fd|0.5}} seconds otherwise. The charge does not ramp up in speed while a target is grabbed.
params.description3: If '''Skarner's''' attached target collides with terrain, the charge ends, detaching them from him, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|1.1}} seconds, and reducing ''Ixtal's Impact's'' {{sti|cooldown}} by 35%.
params.leveling3: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 150}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 6% of his '''maximum''' health)}}}}
params.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Skarner''' ends ''Ixtal's Impact''. If a target has been grabbed, he detaches them from himself.
params.description5: ''Ixtal's Impact ends immediately if '''Skarner''' becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or is affected by any form of {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}, during the charge. The grabbed target is detached if this occurs. While the target is grabbed, they are attached to '''Skarner''' 200 units in front of him.''
params.flavorsound: {{sm2|Skarner_Original_EStun_2.ogg}} ''{{tt|"I am calamity!"|Voice line plays upon pushing target into terrain}}''
params.notes:
* While ''Ixtal's Impact'' is active, '''Skarner's''' movement speed is set to a static amount that cannot change by any means other than by the ability itself.
** Any movement speed modifiers gained before or during the charge are retained however, and will take effect after the charge if the duration permits.
* The {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} from grabbing a target is {{as|300|ms}} only if '''Skarner's''' movement speed was between {{as|350|ms}} and {{as|850|ms}} at the time.
** If '''Skarner''' was at less than {{as|350 movement speed}} when he grabbed the target, his total movement speed is instead set to {{as|650|ms}}. If he was at {{as|950 movement speed}}, his total movement speed is set to the cap of {{as|1150|ms}}.
* '''Skarner''' gains a slightly larger field of view during ''Ixtal's Impact's'' charge.
* ''Ixtal's Impact's'' attachment depends on the application of the {{tip|suppression}}; if the suppression is not applied, neither is the attachment. Similarly, if the suppression is removed, so is the attachment.
** If the target resists the suppression through {{tip|cc-immune|total crowd control immunity}}, {{tip|displacement immune|displacement immunity}}, or a {{tip|spell shield}}. '''Skarner''' will not attach them to himself, causing the charge to end instantly.
** If the target removes the suppression by any means, including with an applicable {{tip|cleanse}} effect or {{tip|dispel}}, they will detach themselves from '''Skarner''' immediately which forces the charge to end instantly and not apply any damage.
* '''Skarner''' can move up to 550 units beyond the outer-edge of the battlefield with the charge.
** Once he has surpassed this boundary, ''Ixtal's Impact'' ends immediately and '''Skarner''' is moved to the nearest valid space.
* ''Ixtal's Impact'' can interact with [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated terrain]].
* If '''Skarner''' is inside terrain when the effect ends, he will be moved to the nearest valid space.
* Enemies cannot see '''Skarner''' while he is inside terrain, unless they grant sight into the area of terrain he is inside (such as with {{ai|Hawkshot|Ashe}} or {{ai|Heightened Senses|Quinn}}) or have {{tip|unobstructed vision}}.
** However, enemies will be notified when '''Skarner''' is inside nearby terrain while within a certain distance of him. An indicator will be visible to the enemy player's perspective to represent this.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Skarner''' is charging:
{{ct|attack=false|move=Allowed, but cannot input movement commands.|cast=false|items=false|consume=false|spells=true,false,false,false,false|interrupts=death,root,ground,silence}}
* A special indicator for ''Ixtal's Impact's'' direction and expected ending location is visible to '''Skarner''' only during his charge.

params.notes:
* ''Impale's'' attachment depends on the application of the {{tip|suppression}}; if the suppression is not applied, neither is the attachment. Similarly, if the suppression is removed, so is the attachment.
** If a target resists the suppression by being {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}}, {{tip|displacement immune}}, or having a {{tip|spell shield}}, '''Skarner''' will not attach them to himself.
*** If all targets hit resist the suppression, '''Skarner''' will fail to attach any of them to himself and thus will not initiate ''Impale'', causing the ability to behave as if no valid impale targets were hit.

*** If all targets remove the suppression, ''Impale'' ends prematurely and is cancelled for '''Skarner'''.
* If a target would be inside of terrain at the end of the effect, they are moved to the nearest valid space.
* If a target would be on the other side of a wall, they are moved to the same side as '''Skarner'''.
* During ''Impale'', '''Skarner''' always faces in the direction of the nearest attached target.
